title: Dashanpu, Zigong: Middle Jurassic dinosaur quarry
summary: At Dashanpu in Zigong, Sichuan, a sandstone 3–5 metres thick near the base of the Lower Shaximiao Formation holds the greatest known concentration of Middle Jurassic dinosaurs, including the sauropods Shunosaurus and Dashanpusaurus, the stegosaur Huayangosaurus and Agilisaurus. The beds are lake and river deposits of a red-bed basin; the formation's exact age is debated.

uncertainty.note: Sources give only "Middle Jurassic"; the pin date is a mid-period placement with wide uncertainty, not a measured age. The formation's exact age is debated.

as_recorded.value: Bajocian to Bathonian (invertebrates) vs Bathonian-Callovian-Oxfordian (zircon); maximum depositional age 166.0 ± 1.5 Ma at Yunyang

where.historical_name: Sichuan Basin, eastern Asia (Middle Jurassic); no polities existed

importance.justification: Type locality of the Shunosaurus Fauna and the greatest known concentration of Middle Jurassic dinosaurs.

beats.caption: Lake and river muds and sands, mostly purplish-red mudstone with sandstone, filled a red-bed basin in what is now the Sichuan Basin.
A sandstone near the formation base holds Shunosaurus, Dashanpusaurus, Huayangosaurus and Agilisaurus.
First uncovered in 1972, the site has yielded 29 species in 26 genera and is the type locality of the Shunosaurus Fauna.
